failed_conditions.quote: Fixes the issue of the failing multiple chainable controller activation by the resource manager. This is happening due to the newly added code in the PR: #1218 under the method `prepare_command_mode_switch` method

loudness.quote: Could not switch controllers since prepare command mode switch was rejected.

resolution.quote: I confirm that you fix works for us once backported to humble.

notes: E1 confirmed: issue #1400 body carries the exact error log ("[ERROR ...] [resource_manager] [prepare_command_mode_switch() ...] Not acceptable command interfaces combination: ... Not available: [...]") and the failing unit test, and the maintainer confirms reproduction ("I was able to reproduce the same. I've just fixed it in the PR #1401."). E2 stop_step 6 (library API) is correct: controller_manager and hardware_interface are separate packages in one repo, and the defect is a call order/precondition crossing the API boundary (prepare_command_mode_switch is called before the chained reference interfaces are made available); the tree step 2 explicitly counts a wrong order crossing the boundary as interface, not internal. Class `other` is the right bucket (call-order precondition, no dedicated class). Loudness loud_documented/activate matches the resource-manager diagnostic and the switch rejection at activation. Resolution observed is backed by the reporter's confirmation "I confirm that you fix works for us once backported to humble." I note the spec's honest caveat that the resolved_rev (humble backport #1411 merge 69487aeb) is a public equivalent of the reporter's unreleased cherry-pick, not the exact artifact tested; this does not change the verdict.
